info.name: Appointment Booking API
info.description:
Walks the appointment workflow: providers create single and bulk slots, customers browse and book, double-booking and overlap protection, provider confirmation and cancellation with reasons, customer cancellation, withdrawing slots, the profile, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8120). Repeatable: it registers a fresh customer and creates slots 3 to 8 weeks ahead in the early morning.

exec: const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 864e5); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

item.name: Register a fresh customer for this run
A slot in the past is rejected
A five minute slot is rejected
A slot running past midnight is rejected
An overlapping slot is a conflict
A slot that starts when the first ends is fine
Bulk: end before start is rejected
Bulk: far too many slots is rejected
Bulk: cut two hours into four slots
Bulk over existing slots is all or nothing
The calendar holds exactly six slots

exec: pm.test("Six, in time order", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(l.every(s => s.status === "AVAILABLE")).to.be.true; pm.expect(l[0].start < l[5].start).to.be.true; });

item.name: The dentist adds an overlapping time of their own

exec: pm.test("Five providers, the physician has open slots", () => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.least(5); const m = list.find(p => p.title === "General physician"); pm.expect(m.freeSlots).to.be.above(0); pm.collectionVariables.set("mehtaId", m.id); });

item.name: The physician's slots on the day

exec: pm.test("Six open slots, no personal details", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(l.every(s => s.status === "AVAILABLE" && s.customerName === null)).to.be.true; });

item.name: The provider's own calendar needs the provider role

exec: pm.test("Pending with the provider's details", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(a.providerName).to.include("Mehta"); pm.expect(a.number).to.match(/^AP-\d+$/); pm.expect(a.canCancel).to.be.true; pm.expect(a.canConfirm).to.be.true; });

item.name: Someone else cannot take the same slot
The same customer cannot be in two places at once

exec: pm.test("Already booked then", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already have an appointment"));
pm.test("Both, soonest first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].start < l[1].start).to.be.true; });

item.name: The first slot now shows as taken, without the customer

exec: pm.test("Two taken, four open", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.filter(s => s.status === "PENDING").length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l.filter(s => s.status === "AVAILABLE").length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(l.every(s => s.customerName === null)).to.be.true; });

item.name: The provider sees requests, pending first

exec: pm.test("Both of this customer's requests", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l.every(a => a.customerUsername === pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser"))).to.be.true; });

pm.test("Confirmed by the provider", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("CONFIRMED"); pm.expect(a.confirmedBy).to.eql("dr.mehta"); pm.expect(a.canConfirm).to.be.false; });

item.name: The provider must give a reason to cancel
The provider cancels the second request

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the provider", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(a.cancelledBy).to.eql("dr.mehta"); });

item.name: A cancelled request cannot be confirmed
The customer sees the provider's reason

exec: pm.test("Reason shown", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].cancelReason).to.eql("Called away to an emergency"); });

item.name: The freed slot can be booked by someone else

exec: pm.test("The confirmed one", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].number).to.match(/^AP-/); });

item.name: The customer cancels with a reason

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the customer", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(a.cancelReason).to.eql("Feeling better"); pm.expect(a.cancelledBy).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: Book a slot, then try to withdraw it
A slot with an appointment cannot be withdrawn

exec: pm.test("Cancel the appointment first", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Cancel the appointment"));

item.name: Another provider cannot withdraw it either
A withdrawn slot cannot be booked
